paragraphs.text: Shifts last three hours and start at 9 am or 1 pm. Volunteers under 18 must work alongside an adult volunteer and may not lift boxes heavier than 10 kilograms.
Food that is past its use-by date is thrown away, even if it looks fine; food past its best-before date may still be given out. Any accident, however small, is written in the book by the door.

items.prompt: Every shift is three hours long.
Food past its best-before date is thrown away.
Small accidents do not need to be recorded.
